response.text:
Two documents/permits expire in the next six months:

- **Residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis)** with Stadt Musterstadt – Ausländerbehörde [party:pty_7jmdemeegmw0], expires **Mon 30 Nov 2026** [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. - **Passport** (Ministry of Interior) [party:pty_z1se3q2nn3k3], expires **Wed 10 Feb 2027** [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse]. Renew it before then if still needed for travel.

You can mark either as done in Ordnung once handled, or add them to your calendar as reminders.
